query_normalized: analyzing the trade‑off between prompt size and code generation quality computer science
rationale: This paper satisfies criterion (b) by measuring the impact of context size (via API retrieval and index expansion) on code generation quality, which directly addresses the user's variables of prompt size and generation quality within the code generation domain. Additionally, it touches on criterion (a) by investigating the mechanism of how specific context elements (APIs) influence the output quality, a core component of the prompt-size trade-off.
